subject.title: Feature request: per-group debounceMs for WhatsApp (and other channels)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public WhatsApp `channels.whatsapp.groups.<jid>.debounceMs` override, and if so should it be WhatsApp-only or part of a broader cross-channel group debounce contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a public config surface whose precedence, docs, and cross-channel scope require maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow WhatsApp group override
options.body: Add `debounceMs` only to WhatsApp group config, with precedence over account, channel, and global inbound debounce and focused tests/docs.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel debounce design
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define one shared group debounce contract for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and other group-capable channels.

options.title: Reject this config surface
options.body: Document existing account/channel debounce and routing-agent workarounds instead of adding another config key.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow WhatsApp group override
recommendation.body: Add `debounceMs` only to WhatsApp group config, with precedence over account, channel, and global inbound debounce and focused tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided maintainer-facing review on this issue and has adjacent schema/debouncer history, making them the best available product/config decision owner.
